@title NoxCompute
 @notice The entry point contract for the Nox TEE compute protocol.
 It's role includes:
 - Managing the access control list (ACL) for encrypted handles
 - Validating handle proofs issued by a trusted gateway
 - Wrapping plaintext values into public handles
 - Triggering off-chain TEE computations through event emissions

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

addViewer(bytes32,address).details: Only an admin can add a viewer. The viewer address cannot be address(0).

params.viewer: The address to grant viewer role

allow(bytes32,address).details: Caller must have access (transient OR persistent) to the handle

params.account: The address to grant admin role

allowPublicDecryption(bytes32).details: The caller must be allowed to use the handle.      If not, the function reverts.

params.handle: Handle to mark as publicly decryptable.

allowTransient(bytes32,address).details: To grant transient access, the caller must already have permission on `handle`.      Transient access only lasts for the current transaction. It is the responsibility      of the application contract to convert this into persistent access via `allow()`      if needed.

returns.success: Bool handle indicating if the burn succeeded

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

returns.result: Bool handle indicating greater than or equal

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

params.kmsPublicKey: KMS public key for ECIES encryption.

initializeV2().details: The same logic is also called in `initialize()` for fresh deployments.The call to this function does not need to be protected because it does not do any critical operations.

returns._0: Whether the account can access the handle (persistent or transient).
Whether the handle is publicly decryptable.

isViewer(bytes32,address).details: Returns true if any of the following conditions are met:      - The handle is publicly decryptable      - The account was added as a viewer via `addViewer`      - The account has persistent access (is allowed) on the handle

returns._0: Whether the account can view the handle.

returns.result: Bool handle indicating less than or equal

returns.success: Bool handle indicating if the mint succeeded

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.ifFalse: Value handle if condition is false
params.ifTrue: Value handle if condition is true

params.newKmsPublicKey: Compressed SEC1 secp256k1 public key (33 bytes)

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

returns.success: Bool handle indicating if the transfer succeeded

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

returns._0: decryptedResult The decrypted value extracted from the proof if the proof is valid, or reverts otherwise

params.owner: The address of the handle owner

InvalidEmptyBytes().notice: Error thrown when bytes parameter is empty

InvalidProof(bytes,string).notice: Error thrown when the input proof is invalid

InvalidZeroAddress().notice: Error thrown when account address is zero

NotAllowed(bytes32,address).notice: Error thrown when an account is not allowed to use a handle

NotPubliclyDecryptable(bytes32).notice: Error thrown when a handle is not publicly decryptable

PublicHandleACLForbidden().notice: Error thrown when attempting an ACL mutation on a public handle

UnauthorizedSender(address).notice: Error thrown when sender doesn't have access to the handle

UndefinedHandle().notice: Error thrown when an operand is bytes32(0), indicating an undefined handle

Allowed(address,address,bytes32).notice: Emitted when admin role is granted

MarkedAsPubliclyDecryptable(address,byte.notice: Emitted when a handle is marked as publicly decryptable

ViewerAdded(address,address,bytes32).notice: Emitted when viewer role is granted

add(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs an addition between two encrypted values without overflow check.

addViewer(bytes32,address).notice: Adds a viewer for a specific handle

allow(bytes32,address).notice: Grant admin role to another address for a specific handle

allowPublicDecryption(bytes32).notice: Mark a handle as publicly decryptable.

allowTransient(bytes32,address).notice: Allows the use of `handle` by address `account` for this transaction.

burn(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Computes a confidential burn operation. If the burn operation fails (e.g., due to underflow), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the newBalanceFrom and newTotalSupply handles will contain the same values as the input balanceFrom and totalSupply handles.

disallowTransient(bytes32,address).notice: Revokes transient access to `handle` for address `account` within the current transaction.

div(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a division between two encrypted values without safety checks. In the case of a division by zero, the result will be as follows:  - For unsigned integers uintN: encrypted MAX_UintN (i.e., 2^N - 1)  - For signed integers intN: encrypted MAX_IntN (i.e., 2^(N-1) - 1)

eq(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks equality between two encrypted values

ge(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks if left operand is greater than or equal to right operand

gt(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks if left operand is greater than right operand

initialize(address,address,bytes,address.notice: Initializes the proxy contract state for a fresh deployment.

initializeV2().notice: Initializer of 0.2.0 upgrade for already deployed proxies.Emits zero handle seeds for existing proxies.

initializeV3(address,address).notice: Initializer of 0.2.3 upgrade for already deployed proxies.Migrates the contract from `OwnableUpgradeable` to `AccessControlUpgradeable`: initializes AccessControl, grants the two roles, and clears the legacy Ownable storage slot.

isAllowed(bytes32,address).notice: Returns whether the account is allowed to use the `handle`, either due to allowTransient() or allow().

isPubliclyDecryptable(bytes32).notice: Checks whether a handle is publicly decryptable.

isViewer(bytes32,address).notice: Returns whether the account can view the handle.

kmsPublicKey().notice: Returns the KMS public key used for ECIES encryption.

le(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks if left operand is less than or equal to right operand

lt(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks if left operand is less than right operand

mint(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Computes a confidential mint operation. If the minting operation fails (e.g., due to overflow), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the newBalanceTo and newTotalSupply handles will contain the same values as the input balanceTo and totalSupply handles.

mul(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a multiplication between two encrypted values without overflow check.

ne(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Checks inequality between two encrypted values

proofExpirationDuration().notice: Returns the proof expiration duration in seconds.

safeAdd(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs an addition between two encrypted values with overflow check. If the operation succeeds, the value of the success handle will be an encrypted `true` and the result handle's value will be the encrypted sum. If the operation fails (e.g., due to overflow), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the result handle will contain an encrypted `0`.

safeDiv(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a division between two encrypted values with division-by-zero check. If the operation succeeds, the value of the success handle will be an encrypted `true` and the result handle's value will be the encrypted quotient. If the operation fails (e.g., due to division by zero), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the result handle will contain an encrypted `0`.

safeMul(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a multiplication between two encrypted values with overflow check. If the operation succeeds, the value of the success handle will be an encrypted `true` and the result handle's value will be the encrypted product. If the operation fails (e.g., due to overflow), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the result handle will contain an encrypted `0`.

safeSub(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a subtraction between two encrypted values with underflow check. If the operation succeeds, the value of the success handle will be an encrypted `true` and the result handle's value will be the encrypted difference. If the operation fails (e.g., due to underflow), the success handle will contain an encrypted `false` and the result handle will contain an encrypted `0`.

select(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Selects between two encrypted values based on a condition

setGateway(address).notice: Sets Gateway wallet address. Only callable by an UPGRADER_ROLE holder.

setKmsPublicKey(bytes).notice: Sets the KMS public key used for ECIES encryption. Only callable by an UPGRADER_ROLE holder.

setProofExpirationDuration(uint256).notice: Sets the proof expiration duration. Only callable by an UPGRADER_ROLE holder.

sub(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Performs a subtraction between two encrypted values without underflow check.

transfer(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Computes a confidential transfer between two balances. The transfer will succeed if the sender has sufficient balance and fail otherwise. If the transfer fails, the success handle will contain an encrypted `false`, the newBalanceFrom and newBalanceTo handles will contain the same values as the input balanceFrom and balanceTo handles.

validateAllowedForAll(address,bytes32[]).notice: Checks whether the account is allowed to use all provided handles. Reverts with NotAllowed if any handle is not allowed.

validateDecryptionProof(bytes32,bytes).notice: Validates the decryption proof issued by the gateway for a given handle. The proof must be signed by the configured gateway. The proof uses a compact serialization: `signature (65 bytes) || decryptedResult (N bytes)`. The signature is placed first (fixed size) so that `decryptedResult` can be variable-length, supporting all current and future types that may exceed 32 bytes (e.g. encrypted strings).

validateInputProof(bytes32,address,bytes.notice: Validates that a handle provided by a user is:   - of expected type   - not expired   - issued for the correct app (caller)   - issued for the correct owner   - issued by the configured gateway (signed by the gateway wallet) or reverts otherwise. Handle format:  1 byte    4 bytes      1 byte  1 byte      25 bytes   [0]     [1------4]     [5]     [6]     [7-----------31] Version    ChainId       Type    Attrs      Pre-handle Proof format:  20 bytes       20 bytes        32 bytes            65 bytes [0-----19]    [20-----39]    [40--------71]    [72------------136]   Owner           App           CreatedAt       EIP-712 signature

wrapAsPublicHandle(bytes32,uint8).notice: Wraps a plaintext value into a deterministic public handle. The resulting handle has bit 0 of the attributes byte (byte 30) unset, meaning it can be non unique, it carries no ACL and is accessible by everyone. The same value and type always produce the same handle.
